In connection with this ongoing evaluation, a restructuring plan was undertaken in the first quarter of 2026, reducing the Company’s workforce by approximately 7% to better align our expenses with revenue and create flexibility to invest in the products, people, and markets that are expected to drive long-term growth and profitability.
We expect international sales, and sales to the Asia region in particular, to continue to account for a large portion of our net revenue in the future.

In addition, for the three and nine-month periods, we recognized $0.3 million and $1.2 million credits, respectively, to stock-based compensation expense which reflects our revised estimate of the portion of unvested equity awards associated with our retired former chief executive officer that may ultimately vest subject to continuous service and based on the Company's forecasted performance.
We believe that cash generated from operations, together with existing sources of liquidity, will satisfy our projected working capital and other cash requirements for at least the next 12 months.

Our cash requirements beyond the next 12 months are subject to a number of uncertainties, including general economic conditions and our ability to generate cash flow from operations; we expect those cash requirements to include funding our operations and capital expenditures.
